specify the kind of service. Ideally this should be a resolvable identifier. For interoperability, there must be an external arrangement between data providers and consumers on the strings that will be used to specify service types.

a document that provides a machine-actionable description of a service instance. Examples include OpenAPI documents, OGC Capabilities documents. a templated URL; parameters are enclosed in curly braces ({..}); parameters are not required. If included, parameters MUST be documented in the query-input element.
